# t3.1 — Capability Inventory Remediation

**Role**: pm  
**Status**: remediated, pending constitution and teamlead gate rerun  
**Task**: Remediate capability criteria, traceability, and product/implementation separation.

## Summary

The PM-owned inventory now:

- separates stakeholder-facing outcomes from downstream delivery constraints;
- removes route, framework, and storage terminology from product success criteria
  and requirement wording while preserving an external-contract boundary;
- defines observable behavior for session eligibility, recovery channels,
  throttling, expiration, onboarding-step availability, unavailable-service
  recovery, limits, and ambiguous outcomes;
- provides one independently testable Given/When/Then acceptance scenario for
  each of REQ-001 through REQ-063;
- preserves all clarified user decisions, six waves, provider truth states, and
  the no-real-money rule.

The remaining CRITICAL constitution finding belongs to the teamlead/constitution
task t3.2. This PM task does not create or claim that constitution compliance.

## Deliverables

- [t1-pm.md](./t1-pm.md) — remediated capability inventory, requirements,
  success criteria, dependencies, constraints appendix, and evidence.
- [t3.1-pm-traceability.md](./t3.1-pm-traceability.md) — 63-of-63
  REQ-to-acceptance-scenario mapping plus observable product definitions.

## Remediated Gate Findings

| Upstream finding | PM remediation | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| HIGH — implementation details mixed into product requirements | Product requirements and success criteria rewritten in outcome language; technical compatibility is isolated in a non-product appendix | `t1-pm.md#Delivery Constraints (Non-Product Appendix)` and `#External Contract Continuity Boundary` |
| HIGH — ambiguous qualifiers in REQ-004/005/010/040/041 | Explicit active-session, verified-channel, 30-minute recovery, 5-in-15-minute throttle, 30-minute pause, onboarding availability, and unavailable-state recovery definitions | `t1-pm.md#Wave 1` and `t3.1-pm-traceability.md#Observable Product Definitions` |
| HIGH — success criteria not consistently technology-neutral | SC-001 through SC-008 rewritten around product outcomes | `t1-pm.md#Success Criteria` |
| HIGH — scenarios did not cover every requirement | AC-001 through AC-063 map one-to-one to REQ-001 through REQ-063 | `t3.1-pm-traceability.md` |
| MEDIUM — technical terminology without plain-language equivalents | Replaced implementation-oriented terms in product clauses with observable history, response, state, and customer guidance language | `t1-pm.md#Six-Wave Product Definition` |
| MEDIUM — insufficient edge-state examples | Added provider rejection, duplicate, timeout, unknown, revocation, accessibility, and legal-blocked scenarios | `t3.1-pm-traceability.md` |
